title: JPremium
description: JPremium is a modern authentication plugin for Minecraft proxy servers (BungeeCord or Velocity).
body:
> # What is JPremium?
JPremium is a plugin designed to handle player authentication. It automatically authenticates Java and Bedrock premium players, with features like username protection, password recovery, and session persistence, ensuring secure, user-friendly access control.

> ## Features:
- Java/Bedrock premium players log in automatically, supports username changes without data loss.
- Optional 2FA via authenticator apps and email-linked password recovery.
- Prevents username impersonation; configurable challenge modes.
- Player sessions persist for same IP/username; unauthenticated players enter limbo with boss bar timer.
- Auto-authenticates Bedrock premiums via Geyser/Floodgate (no Floodgate linking).
- SQLite/MySQL/MariaDB support; SHA256/SHA512/bcrypt hashing.
